lean.fidelity_note: The paper fixes the zero-mean Poisson pressure and normalizes $\max_{[t_0,T]}|\mathbf a(t,0)|=\lambda^{-3/4}$. The formal statement allows any smooth periodic parent pressure satisfying the stated residual and coercivity conditions, and requires only $0<|\mathbf a(t,0)|\le\lambda^{-3/4}$. The pressure estimate remains an upper quadratic-form bound on all of $[0,T]$, rather than an absolute Hessian bound. On $[t_0,T]$, the central gradient retains the term $\widetilde\chi\mathbf a\otimes\kappa$ and an operator-norm error at most $\lambda^{-1/3}$. The formal statement bounds the displayed difference directly, which is equivalent to naming it $E_c$. The envelope exponent is fixed first, and thresholds for the common exponent $b$ and coefficients $\Gamma_P$ are chosen before the parent and expansion. Enlarging those constants preserves the conclusion under the correspondingly stronger smallness condition, as in Lemma 5.8.
lean.name: TorusEuler.Paper.lemma_5_9
